title: FCA publishes landmark review into the impact of AI on retail financial services
mainJudgement: AI governance and resilience should no longer be treated as parallel workstreams. They need a shared operating evidence base.

topSignals.title: FCA publishes landmark review into the impact of AI on retail financial services
topSignals.label: AI governance
topSignals.why: Retail AI is now a customer-outcomes, governance, and control-evidence question, not an innovation side topic.
